question: The average weight of a certain number of apples in a basket was 0.5 kg. If 10 apples with an average weight of 0.7 kg are removed from the basket and 5 apples with an average weight of 0.6 kg are added to the basket, then the average weight of the apples in the basket decreases by 0.1 kg. What was the initial number of apples in the basket?
solution:

The average weight of a certain number of apples in a basket was 0.5 kg.

10 apples with an average weight of 0.7 kg are removed from the basket.

5 apples with an average weight of 0.6 kg are added to the basket.

The average weight of the apples in the basket decreases by 0.1 kg.
